citations.author: AnnRKist
citations.quote_or_claim: One of the tightest of the nineties, featuring a soaring Bird Song, one of the overall best China>Riders, and a Dark Star for the ages. Hornsby goes nuts…
citations.title: Review: Stellar show (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Cnick
citations.quote_or_claim: Beautiful copy. All of the echoes and effects are there that I remember from being on the floor in the second row at this show. Awesome Looks Like->Dark Star…
citations.title: Review: Great Sound (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Yo Ian
citations.quote_or_claim: 35 minutes from my abode. Gave someone a miracle. I got rewarded. Dark Star and every other note. Beaming at my friend at the opening notes. Everyone turning…
citations.title: Review: Best Show (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Waves1000
citations.quote_or_claim: I received a FRONT ROW ticket from the Grateful Dead Office for this show. And if I haven't thanked them yet publicly for that, allow me to do so now. Thank…
citations.title: Review: Must be the front row... (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: GDTrey
citations.quote_or_claim: One of my favorite China > Riders. Jerry and Bruce go off on the Rider. I get chills every time, which happens often when the Dead smoke. I can't say enough…
citations.title: Review: Jerry + Bruce = HOT Rider! (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Darkstr56
citations.quote_or_claim: All hail the all time best 90's "DARKSTAR", well in my opinion:) Really, this is a masterpeice fir the later days. I cant tell you how many times I have said…
citations.title: Review: 4/1/91 (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.quote_or_claim: LOOK AT THE SECOND SET LIST.All i need to say is......This must be 1972!!!!!

citations.quote_or_claim: after you have downloaded the night before go right for this one. Another great show from the boys, the only gripe I have is that the boys really rush through…
citations.title: Review: great stuff (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: donnaruinedthe70s
citations.quote_or_claim: 5 star sound 5 star performance. nice dstar and reprise. great bird song closer. great china > rider >ll rain (echo machine for ll rain is always a good time).…
citations.title: Review: double 5's (gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf)

citations.quote_or_claim: there is oversaturation in a few frequencies ( mostly noticeable in the vocals ) and the stereo imaging seems squashed. my guess would be the original master…

citations.quote_or_claim: One of the best of Spring 91, in my opinion, if not the best in terms of the band's performance (and song choice). However, the sound, although not all that…
